prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop ecommerce homepage decision comp, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, approximately 1536×1024
Primary request: Design the representative homepage for Grădina Kasper, a friendly Romanian vegetable-box shop. The visual idea is “The Kitchen Table Planner”: a weekly family planner and fridge-magnet spirit translated into a mature, well-crafted ecommerce interface. The visitor must immediately understand that these are locally grown vegetable boxes from Brașov and be able to add the featured box to cart.
Input images: Image 1 is the binding reference for friendly rounded typography, green color usage, and restrained playfulness; Image 2 is conceptual inspiration for a three-step how-it-works section only, not its layout; Image 3 is binding inspiration for the existing deep-green rounded footer identity, though the footer need not be visible in this first-viewport comp; Image 4 is catalogue inspiration only, with larger product storytelling required for a small collection of 18 boxes.
Scene/backdrop: A polished browser-width homepage on warm white, with real photographic content areas showing a human greenhouse and freshly harvested vegetables. Compact navigation across the top. Then a bold two-part opening: one side is a candid, natural human-in-the-greenhouse photograph; the other is an oversized featured-box planner module that feels like a neatly pinned kitchen note, structured and shoppable. At the lower fold, reveal a quiet rounded three-step how-it-works strip.
Subject: Grădina Kasper homepage featuring “Cutia Family”, a generous mixed vegetable box with a large authentic product photo, price, weight, next-delivery date, primary add-to-cart action, and a secondary link to all 18 boxes.
Style/medium: high-fidelity production-grade ecommerce UI mockup; friendly rounded grotesk typography; strong editorial hierarchy; large rounded shapes; tactile but subtle paper-label or fridge-magnet cues; disciplined spacing; real photography; warm, human, playful with restraint; mature, not childish.
Composition/framing: full-width desktop page at 1536×1024 landscape. Compact header with the Grădina Kasper carrot mark/name at left, concise navigation in the center, account and cart utilities at right. Hero fills most of the first viewport with a balanced asymmetric 7/5 split and generous margins. Left: headline and human greenhouse photo integrated in one confident rounded field. Right: oversized celery-mist featured-box card with product image, legible product metadata, tomato-coral delivery chip, and a large deep-green call-to-action. At the fold: horizontal three-step strip with simple icons and short labels. Preserve obvious website chrome, grids, buttons, and content rhythm so it reads as a real homepage, not a poster or moodboard.
Lighting/mood: sunlit greenhouse photography, candid human warmth, optimistic and fresh, grounded and trustworthy.
Color palette: deep greenhouse green #075B3A, leaf #B9DE78, celery mist #EAF4D7, tomato coral #F46B4E, warm white #FFFDF7; use coral sparingly for delivery urgency and small accents.
Materials/textures: natural leaves, soil, wooden vegetable crate, recycled box; subtle uncoated-paper tactility only where it reinforces the planner metaphor; otherwise crisp digital UI.
Text (verbatim, spell and render exactly in Romanian):
“Grădina Kasper”
“Acasă”
“Cutii de legume”
“Cum funcționează”
“Despre noi”
“Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”
“Creștem legume netratate, într-o grădină vie, și ți le aducem proaspete la tine acasă!”
“Cutia Family”
“150 RON”
“4–5 kg”
“Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”
“Adaugă în coș”
“Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”
“1. Alegi cutia”
“2. Selectezi livrarea”
“3. Primești proaspăt”
Constraints: Build a coherent responsive-looking design system rather than a one-off illustration. Show exactly one dominant featured-box purchase module above the fold. The headline, product name, price, weight, date, and primary CTA must be visibly legible. Use real photo areas with plausible people and vegetables. Friendly, not luxury. Playful, but restrained. Preserve a clear ecommerce action path. No invented business claims beyond the supplied text.
Avoid: generic ShadCN cards, generic SaaS dashboard aesthetics, glassmorphism, purple, luxury styling, sterile minimalism, childish cartoons, excessive stickers, loud patterns, tiny product cards, stock-template hero composition, poster-like image, phone mockups, perspective device frames, awards, testimonials, certification marks, star ratings, discount claims, fake statistics, invented logos, watermarks, gibberish text, misspelled Romanian copy.
